label: No placebo
rationale: This is a single-group cohort study with all participants receiving standard ALS care plus questionnaires and blood sampling. The record describes stratification by weight loss, not assignment to placebo or any comparison arm, so no placebo comparator is used.

evidence.quote: ALS patients will be stratified in 4 groups
Participants will undergo high quality standard care

title: French-German Cohort Study to Determine Factors Associated With Weight Loss in Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
